import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
text=data.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    if l.strip()=='' : continue
    try:
        o=json.loads(l)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('level')=='error' and 'code' in o:
        codes.append(o['code'])
out={'codes':codes,'invalid_lines':invalid}
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); f.write('\n')
print(out)
EOF
md5 scratch/log.jsonl; cat scratch/errors.json
